objective: Remove arbitrary numeric palette identity from structural interpretation and policy tie-breaking while preserving exact raw colors and color-causal evidence.

source_baseline.resolution_rule: Run acceptance only from the clean implementation commit containing the repair and this declaration; bind its commit, tree, first-party source hash, seed schedule, and raw artifact hash.

frozen_failure.reconciliation: Frozen evidence contains two palette failures and two action-remap failures. Stage 04 owns only the two palette cases; Stage 05 owns the two remaps.
frozen_failure.diagnosed_leak: Raw numeric color enters symbolic entity kind/group/ID; lexicographic entity-ID tie-breaking selects the mover and target differently after an otherwise bijective palette relabeling.

representation_contract.raw_receipts: GridFrame cells, palettes, frame/blob hashes, deltas, component raw colors, and transformation evidence remain exact and immutable.
representation_contract.derived_roles: A level-scoped registry assigns at most 16 canonical palette classes from first-observed background/geometry/occupancy evidence without using numeric color as a rank or identifier.
representation_contract.ambiguity: Structurally indistinguishable colors may share an explicit ambiguous class; the implementation must not manufacture a unique semantic role from the numeric label.
representation_contract.stability: Once assigned within a level, raw-color to canonical-class identity is stable across movement and checkpoint/resume; newly observed colors are added without rewriting raw history.
representation_contract.color_causality: Raw color remains available to tracking and executable recolor/color-sensitive rules. Palette equivariance applies to joint bijective relabeling, not one-sided changes that alter observed mechanics.

procedural_paired_suite.palette_domain: all 16 ARC colors, including mappings where the measured background is not zero
procedural_paired_suite.permutation_derivation: For each environment seed and permutation index 0..7, shuffle range(16) with random.Random(derive_seed(seed, 'build-001-stage04-palette-<index>')); deterministically rotate once if identity.
procedural_paired_suite.preset: FULL decision features with automatic checkpoint persistence omitted only in the bulk timing harness; separate checkpoint/resume cases exercise default persistence

acceptance.threshold_policy: Any miss makes the stage PARTIAL or FAILED_MECHANISM; do not weaken the 100 percent threshold after seeing results.

checkpoint_resume_suite.checkpoint_boundary: after one complete action/consequence boundary when the episode remains nonterminal
checkpoint_resume_suite.acceptance: Registry serialization, restored symbolic projection, next action, final terminal result, trace verification, and no-resubmission invariant all match the uninterrupted counterpart.

color_causal_controls.joint_relabeling: Applying the same bijection to before and after observations preserves the canonical transition/effect projection.
color_causal_controls.one_sided_recolor: Changing only one side remains distinguishable and retains RECOLOR or color-sensitive rule evidence.
color_causal_controls.acceptance: 100 percent of jointly relabeled controls are equivalent and 100 percent of one-sided recolors remain distinguishable.

decision_rule.pass: Both historical failures complete with exact paired behavior; all 256 procedural pairs, 16 restart pairs, and all color-causal controls meet their frozen 100 percent predicates; raw provenance and the 16-entry bound hold.
decision_rule.partial: The generic representation repairs the historical cases and materially improves the procedural matrix but at least one frozen predicate misses; preserve every failing seed/permutation.
decision_rule.failed_mechanism: Historical palette behavior remains broken, raw provenance is erased, one-sided color causality becomes indistinguishable, or the registry uses numeric color/game identity as semantic truth.
decision_rule.failed_infrastructure: The clean-source or deterministic harness cannot execute within the declared local resource envelope; preserve exact failure and do not substitute public-game evidence.
